MAJOR RULE CHANGE verified this run: SEC approved amendments to FINRA Rule 4210 on 2026-04-15, FINRA published Regulatory Notice 26-10 on 2026-04-20, effective 2026-06-04, eliminating the pattern day trader definition, the four-in-five-days test, the 6 percent exception, the $25,000 minimum equity requirement, day-trading buying power and the day trade call in their entirety; replaced by new Rule 4210(d)(2) intraday margin deficit determination on any day with an IML-reducing transaction, real-time blocking or end-of-day call, with regular maintenance and the $2,000 minimum unchanged, portfolio margin accounts under $5 million now requiring intraday risk monitoring, an 18-month phase-in to 2027-10-20, and Notice 26-11 deleting the old day-trading interpretations. This obsoletes the 8/18 Q3 margin framing and any $25,000 PDT answer in prior drills; flagged in today's email that item banks will lag. Also verified: OBBBA (H.R. 1, signed 2025-07-04) doubled the 529 K-12 cap to $20,000 per beneficiary from 2026-01-01 and broadened qualified K-12 expenses past tuition to books, curriculum and instructional materials, non-relative tutoring and standardized/AP/admission test fees plus homeschool and credentialing programs, with state conformity not universal, while Coverdell stays $2,000 unindexed, contributions stop at 18, use by 30, MAGI phaseout $95k-$110k single and $190k-$220k joint, and the 529-to-Roth rollover needs a 15-year-old account with a $35,000 lifetime cap; option exercise is not a taxable event and the option holding period does not tack, so stock basis is strike plus premium with the clock starting the day after exercise (a 13-month LEAPS exercised then sold weeks later is short-term, while the closing sale of that same LEAPS is long-term), and Section 1234(b) makes a writer's lapse or closing-purchase result always short-term; Rule 174 aftermarket delivery 25 days listed/Nasdaq IPO, 90 days OTC-only IPO, 40 days non-reporting follow-on, 0 for reporting follow-on, with Rule 172 access-equals-delivery (blank check excluded) and the 15c2-8 48-hour rule; USA consent to service of process is filed once and permanent, registration effective noon of the 30th day, withdrawal effective 30 days later with 1-year continuing jurisdiction, and bonds reachable only against those with custody or discretion. Single send, no duplicate this run (verified by subject search returning one thread).

Verified by web search before writing: strategy-based margin treats a debit spread as net debit paid in full and a credit spread as strike differential less net credit deposited and held, which equals max loss in both cases (brokers may cap the credit-spread requirement at the uncovered short requirement, and retirement accounts add a $2,000 cash spread reserve, both beyond exam scope); the SEC Division of Corporation Finance no-action letter dated 2025-03-12 deems verification satisfied under 506(c) at a $200,000 minimum investment for a natural person or $1,000,000 for an entity, conditioned on a written representation of the specific Rule 501(a) category relied on, a representation that the investment is not third-party financed for the purpose of participating, and no actual knowledge to the contrary, with binding commitments counting and the letter being interpretive rather than a new formal safe harbor; accredited investor dollar thresholds are UNCHANGED as of Sept 2026 ($200k/$300k income two years, $1M net worth excluding primary residence) and the credential path remains only Series 7, 65 and 82, with the INVEST Act (H.R. 3383) to index them passed by the House in Dec 2025 and still in the Senate; separately the qualified client thresholds under Advisers Act Rule 205-3 DID rise on 2026-04-28 to $1.4M AUM or $2.7M net worth effective 2026-06-29 for new advisory relationships, which is a different test and a likely distractor; death of a customer means cancel all open orders including GTC, mark the account deceased, freeze activity pending documents, with trading after death charged under FINRA Rule 2010 even absent knowledge, and a TOD designation controls over the will and avoids probate; USA treats a gift of assessable stock as offer plus sale because the recipient assumes assessment liability while a stock dividend is excluded, every warrant, right or convertible offer includes an offer of the underlying, bonus securities are conclusively presumed part of the purchase, and Section 405 bars representing that registration, notice filing or an exemption means the Administrator approved or verified anything.
